text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When the sun peeks out from the
clouds, Ryan
and Dober pop into my
head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You see, a little while ago, when there
was a
sudden shower of rain, I went to
give them an
umbrella...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lest I slip and fall, I walked extra
carefully, and
by the time I arrived the
rain had stopped.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the two of them insisted on
using the
umbrella in the sun, so as not
to let my efforts go
to waste. Hehe, it's a
very heartwarming memory.
